candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: u+ is the normalized mean velocity (dimensionless) typically formed by dividing a velocity scale by the friction velocity u_tau. Using the provided six input quantities (y, rho_w, mu_w, rho, mu, u_tau) the only independent dimensional parameters are length (y), mass density (rho, rho_w), dynamic viscosity (mu, mu_w) and velocity (u_tau). All variables’ SI dimensions are well-known, so confidence is high that these inputs fully describe the dimensional space relevant for forming the dimensionless u+. The constraint that the power of wall units (constructed from rho_w, mu_w and u_tau) equals 1 in the INPUT and 0 in the OUTPUT is satisfied by treating u_tau as the velocity scale and ensuring u+ is dimensionless.
